integrity: Proof is uniform; finite standalone simplicial-collapse replay is corroborative, not the all-parameter proof. No independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: Proves a one-edge flag-complex fault classification only for n >= 4p+2; no recomputed metric, multi-fault, n-minimality, or independent literature uniqueness claims.
title: A sharp edge-fault simple-homotopy threshold in sparse cyclic flag complexes
